title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: deferred replies / three chapters of human testimonies
pass_a_gloss: By what counsel you did it Placeus does not know: when in the Theses he met the arguments from Rom. 5 and offered you all his replies to run through and refute, you yet relegated them to chapter IX of your treatise with no mention at all in this place where you treat those arguments—three chapters even interposed between them and this treatment, by which you try to crush his view with human testimonies.
pass_b_english: But by what counsel it was done by you, I do not know: that when in the Theses I went to meet the arguments which are drawn from Rom. 5, and proposed to you all my replies to be run through and refuted, you yet relegated them to chapter IX of your treatise with no mention at all of them made in this place where you treat those arguments, three chapters even being interposed between them and this treatment of yours, by which you try to crush my opinion with human testimonies.
source_text: Quo autem consilio a te sit factum, nescio, quod cum in Thesibus obviam iverim argumentis quae ex Rom. v. ducuntur, & meas responsiones omnes tibi percurrendas ac refellendas proposueris, tu tamen eas ad caput usque IX. tractatus tui relegasti nulla prorsus earum mentione facta hoc loco, quo argumenta illa tractas, interpositis etiam inter eas & hanc tuam tractationem tribus capitibus, quibus meam sententiam humanis testimoniis opprimere conaris.

choices.choice: Replies pushed to Cap IX; three chapters of human testimonies interposed
